numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Failures appear when seconds sit just below a half-unit boundary of the last displayed digit, e.g. Angle("1d2m59.49999s") at precision 0. With fields=1 they appear when minutes plus seconds/60 are near 30, e.g. 285d29m41.76s.
